panels.title: Risk alert score

options.content:
**Risk alert score (0–100)**

Based on siem-demo http-log in the selected time range (`$__range`).

| Item | Points | Cap |
|------|--------|-----|
| Auth failure 401/403 | 1 / event | **40** |
| Rate limit 429 | 2 / event | **20** |
| Script UA | 5 / event | **20** |
| URI traversal | 10 / event | **20** |
| **Total** | | **100** |

**Levels** — 0–19 normal · 20–39 watch · 40–59 caution · 60–79 elevated · 80–100 critical

panels.title: Global threat map (source)

options.content:
**What** — Many calls to the sensitive API (`/siem-demo/loan/customers`) with a **bad apikey** in a short window

**Why it matters** — Key/token stuffing or automated auth probing. Higher priority when consumer is null and one IP dominates

**What to look for** — Spike in **401/403** on the right totals/trend, skewed bars by client_ip, consecutive failures in logs

**Response** — Block IP/UA, review bot-detection and key rollover. If 200 follows, escalate to **001b / 007**

**Demo** — UI `KG-API-001` → **Run** / **Evaluate**

**Fired (demo)** — 401/403 ≥ 10 within ~2m

**Response type** — A (account/session)

targets.expr: sum by (client_ip) (count_over_time({log_source="http-log"} |= `/siem-demo/loan/customers` | json | response_status=`401` or response_status=`403` [$__interval]))

options.content:
**What** — A streak of **401/403** followed by **200** on the same sensitive route

**Why it matters** — Valid credentials obtained after guessing/stuffing, or session takeover (DE-002-like)

**What to look for** — Trend shows fail curve then success(200). Confirm same client_ip timeline in logs

**Response** — Revoke the consumer key, check IdP sessions. If ID walk or bulk follows → **007**

**Demo** — UI `KG-API-001b` → **Run** / **Evaluate**

**Fired (demo)** — fails ≥ 3 then success ≥ 1

**Response type** — A

**What** — Many **distinct IDs** on `/customers/{id}` with a valid key in a short window

**Why it matters** — Object-level authz flaw (BOLA) or automated browsing when the app returns others' data by ID alone

**What to look for** — Surge of customers **200**, sequential/scattered IDs in URI logs (demo: distinct-ID threshold)

**Response** — Ticket app authz review. Tighten ACL/OPA/validator/limits. Large volume → **005**

**Demo** — UI `KG-API-002` → **Run** / **Evaluate**

**Fired (demo)** — distinct customer id ≥ 12 / 2m

**Response type** — F (+A)

**What** — Consumer-scoped RLA exceeded → **429**

**Why it matters** — Automated scraping/abuse or batch surge. Without limits the same pattern can become quiet exfil

**What to look for** — 429 total/trend spikes. Interleaved 200 and 429 means collection up to the limit

**Response** — Revisit limit and identifier (consumer). Sensitive route with no limit → correlate with **006**

**Demo** — UI `KG-API-003` → **Run** / **Evaluate**

**Fired (demo)** — 429 ≥ 1

**Response type** — F

**What** — Non-browser UA (`python-requests` / `curl` / `siem-bot`) on a sensitive route

**Why it matters** — Script/bot automation. In production, AND with GeoIP/ASN when possible

**What to look for** — Script UA total, per-UA trend, User-Agent in logs

**Response** — Allowlist approved batch UAs. Otherwise bot-detection and IP restriction

**Demo** — UI `KG-API-004` → **Run** / **Evaluate**

**Fired (demo)** — matching UA ≥ 1

**Response type** — F

**What** — Repeated **large 200** responses (e.g. `/customers/{id}/bulk`) for the same identity

**Why it matters** — Sensitive data collection via API (DE-071/073 mapped to gateway fields)

**What to look for** — bulk 200 count, response size sum, bulk share vs all 200

**Response** — Disable consumer, RLA 0, estimate impact. With prior auth anomaly → **007**

**Demo** — UI `KG-API-005` → **Run** / **Evaluate**

**Fired (demo)** — count ≥ 5 or bytes sum ≥ ~400KB

**Response type** — I (+A)

**What** — Sensitive path (loan/customer) with **no auth or rate-limit plugin** (demo: `/siem-demo/loan/open`)

**Why it matters** — Config/exposure gap to close before traffic alerts (DE-088-like). Not the same as KEV (DE-086)

**What to look for** — open-route call logs + UI **Evaluate** Admin scan gaps (auth/limit missing)

**Response** — Enforce auth + RLA via decK/CI. Remove the gap route or attach protective plugins

**Demo** — UI `KG-API-006` → **Run** (visibility) / **Evaluate** (Admin scan)

**Fired** — sensitive path missing auth or RLA

**Response type** — F (config)

**What** — **001/001b** fires, then **002 or 005** within a short window

**Why it matters** — **Attack chain**: stuffing/theft followed by mass reads (merge as one incident)

**What to look for** — Auth-fail trend and bulk-200 trend rise in the same window

**Response** — Revoke credentials, block IP, temporary route limit. Case types **C+A+I**

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({log_source="http-log"} |= `/siem-demo/loan/customers` | json | response_status=`401` or response_status=`403` [$__range])) + sum(count_over_time({log_source="http-log"} |= `/siem-demo/loan/customers` |= `/bulk` | json | response_status=`200` [$__range]))

options.content:
**Demo** — UI `KG-API-007` → **Run** / **Evaluate**

**Fired** — 001 (or 001b) AND 005 together

**Response type** — C + A + I

**What** — Request URI contains path-manipulation / encoding signatures such as `../`, `%2e%2e`

**Why it matters** — Edge/app attack attempt (DE-046/047-like). Escalate if success or large response

**What to look for** — Signature match count/trend and request.uri in logs

**Response** — validator/WAF and IP block. Normalize paths and review app authz

**Demo** — UI `KG-API-008` → **Run** / **Evaluate**

**Fired (demo)** — URI signature ≥ 1

**Response type** — F

**What** — Proxy is up but **heartbeat http-log stops** (intentional Heartbeat OFF demo)

**Why it matters** — Detection/telemetry gap (DE-091). Loss of visibility is the incident—not an attack payload

**What to look for** — Heartbeat line = 0 (red) while other siem traffic / proxy may still look healthy

**Response** — Restore http-log/Fluent/Loki and hunt the blind window. Response type **J**

**Demo** — UI Heartbeat OFF or `KG-API-009` **Run** / **Evaluate**

**Fired (demo)** — ≥15s silence, 0 events on route, proxy up

**Response type** — J
